description:
About Persona

Persona is the configurable identity platform built for businesses in a digital-first world. Verifying individuals and organizations is harder — but more important — than ever, with AI enabling fraudsters to launch sophisticated accounts at scale and regulations evolving rapidly.

We’ve built Persona to support practically every use case and industry — that’s why we’re able to serve a wide range of leading companies. For example, Reddit relies on Persona for age assurance and verification to comply with online safety regulations, protecting younger users while maintaining a seamless experience. Meanwhile, OpenAI relies on Persona to keep bad actors out, protecting one of the world’s most powerful AI platforms from large-scale abuse in a time when AI is reshaping the way we work and live.

We’re growing rapidly and looking for exceptional people to join us!

About the Role

Persona is building its first dedicated commercial presence in APAC. This opportunity has a main focus in Australia & New Zealand but would be an integral part of the broader APAC team. The person who stands up ANZ sales arm should also be able to support strategic deals, regulatory groundwork, and partnerships across the wider region as we expand as well as attend conferences for lead generation and brand awareness in the region. This is a first-AE, build-from-scratch seat with lots of ownership. It's deliberately broader than a pure sales quota. We're looking for someone who can sell, but who can also be our in-region regulatory partner, lead major tender responses, and build the ecosystem of relationships that a new market requires. If ANZ ramps more slowly than we'd like, this role still delivers regional value through APAC deal support, accreditation groundwork, and partnerships.

Why This Role Is Different

You'll be Persona's first dedicated seller in the region and define the ICP, the partnerships, and the regulatory playbook from first principles. You'll be the person we lean on for the Australian digital identity regulatory regime, for leading complex public-sector and enterprise tenders, and for representing Persona in industry and regulatory forums. You'll operate cross functionally - one week you might be running a strategic enterprise deal; the next, coordinating Product, Legal, Compliance and Security into a government tender, or partnering with our Compliance team on an accreditation path.

What you'll do at Persona:

  • Stand up and own the ANZ sales motion as Persona's first dedicated in-region seller. Build the ICP for ANZ. Today we segment between companies founded in Australia expanding globally vs. companies founded internationally with an Australian arm; how we work with each differs.

  • Contribute to strategic and enterprise deals across APAC, partnering with the AE team and APAC leads on relevant accounts, so the role delivers regional value beyond ANZ.

  • Contribute to Persona's regulatory accreditation strategy across ANZ. Based on prospect feedback, proactively identify where an accreditation or certification would unlock the market, build the internal case for it (the why, backed by concrete deal and buyer examples), and then lead the process end-to-end, in partnership with Compliance and Legal, to secure it.

  • Lead ANZ tender responses (RFP / RFI / RFT) end-to-end from qualification and win-strategy through to coordinating Product, Legal, Compliance and Security inputs into a polished submission. These are major, time-intensive efforts and are often the primary route into government and large regulated buyers across the region.

  • Represent Persona at regional and global identity, fraud, and RegTech conferences, nurturing an existing network into qualified pipeline.

  • Act as the in-region competitive subject-matter expert for opportunities across APAC.

  • Establish relationships with industry, compliance and regulatory bodies to generate leads, identify key stakeholders, secure certifications, advocate for Persona's interests, and help shape regulation.

  • Identify and develop alternative sales channels and strategic partnerships (resellers, distributors, system integrators) to grow regional market presence.

What we're looking for:

  • Proven enterprise / strategic sales experience in identity verification, RegTech, fintech, compliance technology, or an adjacent regulated space — ideally selling into APAC/ANZ.

  • Deep familiarity with the Australian regulatory and compliance landscape (KYC/AML, digital identity, AUSTRAC direction).

  • Experience owning complex, multi-stakeholder deals and coordinating cross-functional inputs (Product, Legal, Compliance, Security) to drive a specific outcome.

  • A genuine networker who is comfortable representing a company on stage and at industry events, and turning that presence into pipeline.

  • Comfort operating in ambiguity and building processes, playbooks, and ICPs where none exist yet.

  • Strong written communication with ability to explain complex technical and regulatory topics clearly.

As part of our interview process, all candidates will be asked to verify their identity with Persona. This step is used solely to confirm that candidates are who they say they are, and will have no impact on hiring decisions.
